related_questions.question: What is proper dental care?
related_questions.snippet: To protect your oral health, take care of your mouth every day. Brush your teeth at least twice a day for two minutes each time. Use a brush with soft bristles and fluoride toothpaste. Brush your tongue too. Clean between your teeth daily with floss, a water flosser or other products made for that purpose.
